estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 63 lines with 8 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 256 MB, CPU: 320m.

warnings.message: Pin versions in apk add. Instead of `apk add <package>` use `apk add <package>=<version>`

securityIssues.suggestion: Review principle of least privilege and immutable tags.

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
